title: Build one tiny proof
summary: A second-contributor example made only from the shared JSON block contract.

blocks.title: Build one tiny proof
blocks.body: Before adding a system, prove the smallest useful behavior in the real environment.

columns.name: Big plan
columns.detail: Many assumptions move together. Failures are hard to read.

columns.name: Tiny proof
columns.detail: One claim is tested. The next decision becomes clearer.

blocks.quote: A small working thing changes the conversation.

blocks.heading: A useful proof
items: Uses the real input and output.
Leaves evidence someone else can inspect.

blocks.heading: Keep it disposable
blocks.body: If the proof teaches you enough, rebuilding it is cheaper than protecting it.
